rows.sql: SELECT COUNT(*) AS so_khoa_hoc FROM khoa_hoc WHERE danh_muc = 'Tiếng Anh' LIMIT 200
SELECT ROUND(AVG(hoc_phi)) AS avg_hoc_phi FROM khoa_hoc WHERE danh_muc ILIKE '%Lập trình%' LIMIT 200
SELECT SUM(so_tien) AS doanh_thu FROM thanh_toan WHERE ngay_thanh_toan >= DATE_TRUNC('MONTH', CURRENT_DATE) - INTERVAL '1 MONTH' AND ngay_thanh_toan < DATE_TRUNC('MONTH', CURRENT_DATE) LIMIT 200
SELECT COUNT(*) AS so_lop_online FROM lop_hoc WHERE hinh_thuc = 'online' LIMIT 200

WITH dt AS (SELECT don_hang_id, SUM(so_tien) AS tong FROM thanh_toan GROUP BY don_hang_id) SELECT COALESCE(SUM(dh.thanh_tien - COALESCE(dt.tong, 0)), 0) AS tong_con_no FROM don_hang AS dh LEFT JOIN dt ON dt.don_hang_id = dh.id WHERE dh.trang_thai IN ('chua_thanh_toan', 'thanh_toan_mot_phan') LIMIT 200

SELECT lh.ca_hoc, COUNT(*) AS so_luot_dang_ky FROM don_hang AS dh JOIN lop_hoc AS lh ON lh.id = dh.lop_hoc_id WHERE dh.trang_thai <> 'da_huy' GROUP BY lh.ca_hoc ORDER BY so_luot_dang_ky DESC LIMIT 200
SELECT COUNT(*) AS so_hoc_vien FROM hoc_vien WHERE thanh_pho ILIKE 'Hà Nội' LIMIT 200

SELECT kh.danh_muc, SUM(tt.so_tien) AS doanh_thu FROM thanh_toan AS tt JOIN don_hang AS dh ON dh.id = tt.don_hang_id JOIN lop_hoc AS lh ON lh.id = dh.lop_hoc_id JOIN khoa_hoc AS kh ON kh.id = lh.khoa_hoc_id WHERE tt.ngay_thanh_toan >= DATE_TRUNC('YEAR', CURRENT_DATE) AND tt.ngay_thanh_toan < CURRENT_DATE + INTERVAL '1 DAY' GROUP BY kh.danh_muc ORDER BY doanh_thu DESC LIMIT 200
SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT dh.id) AS so_don_hang_hoan_tien FROM don_hang AS dh JOIN thanh_toan AS tt ON tt.don_hang_id = dh.id WHERE tt.so_tien < 0 LIMIT 200
SELECT ROUND(CAST(100.0 * SUM(CASE WHEN nguon ILIKE '%facebook%' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) / COUNT(*) AS DECIMAL), 1) AS pct_facebook FROM hoc_vien LIMIT 200
SELECT COUNT(*) AS so_hoc_vien_moi_30ngay FROM hoc_vien WHERE ngay_dang_ky >= CURRENT_DATE - INTERVAL '30 DAYS' LIMIT 200
SELECT SUM(giam_gia) AS tong_giam_gia FROM don_hang WHERE trang_thai <> 'da_huy' LIMIT 200

SELECT kh.trinh_do, COUNT(*) AS so_luot_dang_ky FROM don_hang AS dh JOIN lop_hoc AS lh ON lh.id = dh.lop_hoc_id JOIN khoa_hoc AS kh ON kh.id = lh.khoa_hoc_id WHERE dh.trang_thai <> 'da_huy' GROUP BY kh.trinh_do ORDER BY kh.trinh_do LIMIT 200
SELECT COUNT(*) AS lan_thanh_toan_tien_mat FROM thanh_toan WHERE phuong_thuc ILIKE '%tien_mat%' LIMIT 200
SELECT kh.ten AS khoa_hoc, kh.hoc_phi AS hoc_phi FROM khoa_hoc AS kh ORDER BY kh.hoc_phi DESC LIMIT 1
